description: Marine Oil Terminals is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California State Lands Commission. This point layer represents approximate locations of Marine Oil Terminals that are regulated by the California State Lands Commission. Most terminal points were collected with Collector for ArcGIS, but some were approximated by other means. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California State Lands Commission. Its tags are ArcGIS, CAOpenData, CSLC, California Natural Resources Agency, MEPD. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
